tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Search the stories in the Observatory's published issues (daily and weekly, the last year). Returns the matching stories, best first: headline, summary, source, the original's address, and the story's own address on the Observatory's site. The query takes web-search syntax: words, "a phrase", -word, or.

query.description: What to look for, in English: names, subjects, events.

group.description: Only this product group: management (AI in Management), se (Agentic Software Engineering), science (AI Science Corner), ethiopia, india (India & AI), politics (Interesting Politics).

since.description: Only issues from this date on (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: search_book
tools.description: Search the Book: every note the Observatory's desks have written since late September 2026, each a story read, checked and summarized from one or more sources, many of which never reached an issue. Returns the matching notes, best first: headline, summary, type, tags, desk, source, the original's address, the date, and the credibility label when the check gave one. Same query syntax as search_news.

query.description: What to look for, in English.

desk.description: Only this desk: ai (the AI desk), et (the Ethiopia desk) or in (the India desk).

since.description: Only notes written from this date on (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: latest_issues
tools.description: The Observatory's latest issues, newest first: title, date, the lead story, and the addresses of the issue's page and of its Markdown.

group.description: Only this product group: management, se, science, ethiopia, india, politics.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: One issue in full, as Markdown, with each of its stories' addresses on the Observatory's site and at the source.

id.description: The issue's number, as latest_issues and search_news give it.

tools.name: list_publications
tools.description: What the Observatory publishes, by product group: each publication, what it covers, its days and hour, and the feeds. Readers subscribe at the address given.
